## Observed evidence

Record the exact check, environment, revision, exit code, and result. Link reviewed evidence; do not paste secrets or private logs. Planned checks are not passes.

## Rollback and handoff

State the previous revision, recovery path, private backup requirements, retained records, known limitations, and next decision. Update `docs/HANDOFF.md` and relevant capability/portability guidance.

## Untested or unavailable

Explicitly list unrun checks and unverified cloud services, installers, target machines, or deployment. Do not imply arbitrary code generation when the change only creates declarative apps.
